title: Egypt's Mummified Cats Lived Hard Lives, Skulls Show
paragraphs: Ancient Egyptians loved cats. They also made mummies of many cats.
Scientists studied 131 cat skulls from a place called Beni Hassan. Some skulls showed old injuries. Some showed signs of illness.
The cats may have lived in crowded places. Their lives may not have been easy. But the scientists are not sure. They only had skulls.

questions.q: How many skulls did scientists study?
Are the scientists sure about the cats' lives?
